errors.text_span: Each clinical specialty is represented by a group of three bars, visually distinguished by color: Cardio is represented in orange, Gastro in tan, Infect is orange, Neuro is orange, Obstetrics is orange, and Pediatrics is orange.
errors.evidence: The figure shows seven bars per group: one light blue baseline bar plus six specialty fine-tuning bars. The specialty colors are not all orange; they are distinct shades from light orange to dark brown, as indicated by the legend.

errors.text_span: The shortest bar in the chart, at approximately -27, is the baseline model fine-tuned on Cardio data; the tallest bar, at about -22, is the model fine-tuned on Obstetrics data.
errors.evidence: The baseline Cardio bar is the lowest at about -26.8, but the tallest bars are near -22.0 across several groups; Obstetrics is not uniquely the tallest, and its bars are around -24 to -24.0.

errors.text_span: The bars for each specialty generally appear to decrease in height, moving from left to right across the chart.
errors.evidence: The bars are grouped by x-axis specialty category, not arranged in a left-to-right decreasing trend across the entire chart. Heights vary within each group and do not form a monotonic decrease across the chart.
The description omits the legend at the top center and does not mention the detailed multi-shade color mapping for the six specialty fine-tunings plus the baseline bar.
